text: Describe a holiday resort at a quiet time.
OR
Imagine you have just started a job in a café or restaurant. Describe the place, its customers and
your thoughts and feelings as you do your work.
OR
Narrative Writing
Write a story with the title, ‘The Painting’.
OR
Write a story which begins, ‘A silver moon rose silently into the dark sky, its beauty unnoticed by
the lone figure below.’.
